patch.value: Let operators run their own consent manager: storage-notice switch, replay-private regions, sign-in analytics events

Operators who run an opt-in consent manager at their reverse proxy see two banners today, and the built-in storage notice claims no optional tracking exists, which is wrong for such deployments. pm-web also renders private project, item and account data that must stay out of session-replay tools by default, and sign-in starts are invisible to analytics.

PM_WEB_STORAGE_NOTICE=on|off server setting (default on) documented in the README configuration table; GET /api/ui-config returns {storageNotice:boolean}; With off, cookie-consent.js never shows the notice, never writes pm_cookie_preferences_v1, and data-cookie-settings buttons fall back to a plain link to the operator's cookie-settings legal page; with on behaviour is unchanged; fetch failure falls back to on without throwing; Every private-content container (#main-app, #modal-container, #toast-container, #live-copy-announcement) and dynamically created private overlays carry data-umami-block; the sign-in screen stays unblocked; a test fails if any listed container loses the attribute; Sign-in buttons carry data-umami-event auth_sign_in_started with provider password / oidc; no user name, e-mail or token in any attribute; privacy-policy.html template tells operators running an analytics or consent manager to describe it and explains PM_WEB_STORAGE_NOTICE=off; no visitor-visible vendor names anywhere; Tests cover both setting values over real HTTP and the client script over the built artifact; focused tests, typecheck and lint pass locally

value.author: pi-glm
value.text: Design: (1) New setting PM_WEB_STORAGE_NOTICE (default on; only the exact value 'off' disables) read per request by src/routes/ui-config.ts and exposed to the classic consent script via a minimal unauthenticated GET /api/ui-config -> {storageNotice:boolean}, mounted on the static-asset rate tier. Reusing /api/auth/oidc/config would not fit: the consent script is a classic script without the SPA api() wrapper, runs on the standalone legal pages too, and that route's shape (enabled,label) is OIDC-specific. (2) public/src/cookie-consent.ts resolves the config first (banner starts hidden, so no flash): with on, behaviour is unchanged; with off the banner never shows, nothing is written to pm_cookie_preferences_v1, and [data-cookie-settings] buttons are replaced by plain links to /cookie-settings (the operator's deployed legal page). Every fetch failure (network, non-OK, unparsable body) falls back to on, and the read never throws. (3) data-umami-block added to #main-app, #modal-container, #toast-container, #live-copy-announcement in index.html, plus self-marking for the dynamically created private overlays (graph context menu, graph tooltip, the two graph dependency modals inserted on body, both offline-recovery notices). Sign-in screen stays unblocked. No widely used vendor-neutral attribute convention was found for replay blocking, so only the tracker's own data-umami-block attribute API is used. (4) Sign-in start events: data-umami-event=auth_sign_in_started with provider password (#auth-submit) and oidc (#oidc-login); no user data in any attribute. (5) privacy-policy.html template gained an 'Analytics and consent management' section (operators must describe any analytics/consent manager, and PM_WEB_STORAGE_NOTICE=off is explained); README configuration table documents the setting. Branding rule kept: the vendor name appears nowhere visitor-visible, only in data-umami-* attribute names.

After restoration all three files pass again.

value.text: Continuation: inspected the existing branch, remote head, ready PR 308 and this item; retaining the implementation and unfinished review fixes. Addressing stalled UI-config reads with a bounded fallback covering response bodies, and suppressing password sign-in events on the registration tab. Will verify behavioral reverts in a disposable copy, run local gates, and update the same PR without touching review threads.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof in a disposable non-git copy (the package worktree was not mutated): fixed HTTP tests pass 8/8 without git. Removing the config deadline produces 3 failures in consent-notice (10 pass); restoring passes 13/13. Removing only the switchAuthTab event-update call makes the actual login/register/login execution fail (6 pass, 1 fail); restoring passes 7/7. Changing storageNoticeEnabled to always true fails 3 real HTTP/parser cases (5 pass); restoring passes 8/8. Removing data-umami-block from each of main-app, modal-container, toast-container and live-copy-announcement independently fails the private-container test. Reverting sign-in button markup fails its attribute test. All restored markup passes 7/7. The deadline also cancels the stalled request, covers stalled response bodies, clears a completed read timer, and ignores late off responses.
